title: Frost closure.
officialText:
Where the 97.5-percent value for outside design temperature is 0°F (-18°C) or less, every vent extension
through a roof shall be a minimum of 4 inches (102 mm) in diameter. Any increase in the size of the vent shall be made inside the
structure directly below the roof.
